description:
Arulite Starworks v0.3 The Descriptioning

Requires Magiclib & LazyLib

Currently adds ships, weapons and portraits. More of the same and different in the works.

Attention

If you are experiencing an issue with Persean League fleets not using Conquest/Pegasus this is due to changes in vanilla .faction files in 0.96 where modded ships for some factions such as the PL under the 'priority' tag block the spawning of vanilla capitals. These instructions will remain for anyone still using v0.2b till the next update of the mod.

To resolve this please use this method:

Spoiler

1) Go to Starsector\mods\Arulite Starworks\data\world\factions and find the persean_league.faction file. Open the file then delete the contents and replace them with this:

Spoiler{

"portraits":{

"standard_male":[

"graphics/portraits/arul_persean1.png",

],

"standard_female":[

"graphics/portraits/arul_persean2.png",

],

},

},[close]2) Save & exit this file, if you are starting a new game you shouldn't run into any issues, however, if you are mid-playthrough you will need to enable devMode and save in order to 'refresh' the known ships.

3)To do this go to Starsector\starsector-core\data\config and open settings.json, devMode should be on line 10 and you will need to change the 'false' to 'true' then load your game and save. Next exit Starsector and disable devMode following the prior instructions, this time changing 'true' to 'false'.

You should now have the Conquest and Pegasus spawn in your Persean fleets/markets again alongside the Garuda. This is an issue that will be resolved for the next update of Arulite so you will not have to manually make these adjustments in the future

probably

.

[close]

Changelog:

Spoilerv0.3

Fixed the issue where Persean League fleets would only spawn ships from this mod - instructions on how to fix this will remain up on the forum page for anyone still using v0.2b till the next update

Added descriptions to all guns & most ships

Retuned Adv. PD AI hullmod - further changes soon once i figure out the code involved or might just be removed next update idk

Increased Garuda & Garuda (XIV) DP to 45

Increased Paroxia’s DP to 45 and reduced speed to 40

Fixed an issue with KE/HE drones display name

Added Taykawa HVB

Added Extremity

Resprited Hotchkiss & Bobblin

Reduced Hotchkiss OP to 85, removed large and generally reworked the stats

Added additional flare ports to the Halford (P)

Added Trout

Added Chrysaetos

Removed Babirusa from Luddic Church

Phalanx & GD Interceptor - reworked to only deal half damage to everything but fighters & missiles

Rhino onHit fixed as it was removed for some reason & increased OP to 30

Winnower LRM reworked

Removed Plasma torpedoes

Reduced Pulse Cannon damage to 250, removed EMP damage, flux per shot to 250 and OP to 28

Added Arbalest Battery, Ixel Naval Rifle & Light Flak Cannon

+ other stuff i probably forgor to add to the log since last update

v0.2b

Fixed an issue with the Babirusa's Vast Reserves hullmod mistakenly increasing fighter replacement rate by 5000% instead of decreasing it by 50%

Fixed the MagicLib path for the Advanced PD AI

v0.2a

Updated to 0.96a-RC6 (Still works for RC7)

If you have v0.2 you can just change the game version in the mod_info.json, nothing has actually changed

v0.2

Lexicon: removed 2 bays & reduced OP to 135, Increased Shield eff. To 1.3, Reduced armour to 1000, hull to 10000 & changed shield to frontal, increased DP to 21

Reduced Jotunn OP to 60

Reduced Paroxia OP to 285

Beltshark’s hull reduced to 4000, armour reduced to 500

B-98 increased replacement to 16

F/S-79 increased replacement to 12

F/I-43 reduced flux to 200, increased replacement time to 14

Reduced Super Buffalo’s armour to 900, hull to 8500

Gravity Driver damage increased to 400, flux per shot to 480 & refire to 2.75

Added Garuda XIV

Reduced Brigador hull to 7000 & armour to 800

Added Sosig

Updated and added some descriptions

Fixed an issue with a variant of Modius having more wings than intended

Added Gatto

Added GD Interceptor

Added Pirate Shoota

Added Attendant

Added Babirusa

Added Icon

v0.1b

Removed Magiclib version line

Lowered B-98 OP to 14

Raised F/S-79 OP to 10

Removed bp tags & added SYSTEM tag to Firefly MRM (Bomber)

v0.1a

Removed some old & *** botes/weapons no one wants to see

Fixed spawn weighting in .faction configs (accidentally killed my vanilla .faction configs in the process somehow)

Fixed Advanced PD AI so it is now incompatible with Integrated PD AI

Fixed Elite variants quality

Changed B-98 weapons

Added No weapon flux Hmod to shielded fighters

v0.1

Initial Release

[close]
